It reflects the belief that every Muslim, regardless of gender, has a duty to contribute to the greater good of society, to purify the self, and to seek closeness to Allah. The name Munajidah is not only a source of pride but a reminder of the responsibilities we hold as followers of Islam to continuously better ourselves and work towards building a better world for future generations.
